content: {"paper_id":"lab-061b9da6e2d3","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"we learn category-wise continuous semantic centers via prompt learning to produce the final clustering assignments","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用提示学习获得可学习的类别语义中心并产生最终聚类划分，满足深度聚类利用可学习表示/聚类头获得数据划分的定义。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"we exploit cross-modal relations to produce more discriminative self-supervision signals for clustering","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"图像与文本构成跨模态视图，并显式利用跨模态关系构造聚类自监督信号，符合联合利用视图间关系的多视图设定。"},{"keyword_id":"parameter-efficient-fine-tuning","exact_quote":"we learn category-wise continuous semantic centers via prompt learning","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过提示学习以连续提示/少量可学习参数在预训练VLM上学习语义中心，属于参数高效微调中的连续提示形式。"},{"keyword_id":"vision-language-models","exact_quote":"with the help of vision-language models (VLMs)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以视觉语言模型（VLMs）作为语言辅助图像聚类的核心组件，符合研究模型对象为联合处理视觉与语言的模型。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"large-vision-language-models","reason_zh":"摘要仅出现vision-language models (VLMs)，未给出以大语言模型为语言生成/推理核心的大型视觉语言模型证据。"},{"keyword_id":"contrastive-learning","reason_zh":"摘要提到利用跨模态关系产生更具判别性的自监督信号，但未明确吸引/区分目标或对比损失，无法确定满足对比学习定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
